'''Revelation Eat this, you! Uh, I mean...This eat you!''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Revelation]]
* '''Published:''' 8 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / Vile Gangsters|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Strategy:''' Court Of The Vile Gangster
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 Vile Revelation DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Nothing like feeding people to the Rancor.

The published list has 70 cards.

== Strategy ==

Cam Solusar: Lose Executor and Saber Squadron? I'm apalled! But the other suggestions I'll take. Thanks. Shewski: Ability, Ability, Ability is a good card in any deck, I think. If you get into the right situation, you can really hurt your opponent with it. Take out which Imperials? I am NOT getting rid of any Vader (get that thought of your head), I am NOT getting rid of Grand Admiral Thrawn (my best pilot!), and I am not getting rid of the Saber Squadron pilots. That only leaves Mara Jade, who is also an alien. About the independent starships; they stink! Well, to be fair, they have some useful abilities. But you can't beat an Executor-style beatdown. Example: I was playing a Hidden Base deck. He had a Mon Calamari Star Cruiser at Mon Calamari. I took out Turr Phennir and found Saber 2. Phennir then pulled Fighters Coming In, reducing the cruiser power by 2. I drew a destiny and cleared him out. Then I got almost my entire space force (-Chimaera and Visage) and destroyed his deck! Imagine, beating a Hidden Base without independents!
